S50U26.today_summary: 1064.4 on the Sep future, -3.9 today and 5.6 pts below the 1070 max pain that has anchored all eight sessions in the window. Dealers are short gamma: cumulative net GEX at spot is -7,635 baht/pt with the flip static at 1100, so the 1064-1100 corridor amplifies rather than dampens. The live support is the 1050 put wall (1,880 OI, 290 lots traded today, -2,238 baht/pt of net gamma), not the 16,128-lot 910 block that sits 154 pts away on 117 lots of stale structural OI. Today's tape passes Vol2Vol: price -3.9, put volume +70% to 2,356, put OI +556 and ATM IV +0.49 to 13.92% all moved together.
what_changed: 25D skew widened +2.02 pts in five sessions (0.88 to 2.90) and reached +4.48 at the 10D wing, a monotone protection bid while call IVs slid to 12.5-12.7%.
Put OI built +1,844 contracts (39,785 to 41,629) against +293 calls over four sessions, pushing P/C OI from 2.15 to 2.21.
Total net GEX halved, 5,536 to 2,762 baht/pt, as spot fell 10.9 pts further from the 1100 flip (24.7 to 35.6 pts below it).
Spot crossed beneath max pain, 1075.3 to 1064.4 against a 1070 anchor that has not moved in eight sessions.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Five sessions ago (2026-08-26) the future was 1075.3 with 25D skew at +0.88 and total net GEX at 5,536 baht/pt; today it is 1064.4, skew +2.90 and GEX 2,762 - the long-gamma cushion has halved while the protection bid tripled. The structure itself has not moved: call wall 1100, put wall 910, near put wall 1050 and the gamma flip have been static for eight straight sessions, so the entire change is price sliding 10.9 pts deeper into the short-gamma pocket rather than any wall migration. Put OI added 1,844 contracts against 293 calls while ATM IV expanded 13.00% to 13.92% - OI building plus IV rising plus price falling is the Protection signature, not Unwind. The 1070 max pain has anchored every session in the window and spot has now crossed beneath it, removing the pin-from-above that supported the prior four sessions. The asymmetry to carry forward: -2,238 baht/pt of gamma parked at 1050 means a break there is amplified, while +2,914 and +2,955 at 1080 and 1100 mean rallies are absorbed well before the flip.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1050 / 1020
strategies.rationale: Buys the 15.04% IV 1050 put and sells the 16.94% IV 1020 put, financing the hedge with the richer wing that five sessions of skew steepening (+2.02) has bid up, sited directly over the -2,238 baht/pt short-gamma pocket at 1050 where a break is amplified rather than cushioned.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit 6.05 pts (10.75 paid - 4.70 received); max gain 23.95 pts at or below 1020; breakeven 1043.95.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above the 1070 max pain, or 1080 where net GEX turns +2,914 baht/pt.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1080 / 1100
strategies.rationale: Sells the wing the market is not bidding - 1080 call IV fell 14.73% to 12.71% over five sessions while put IV rose - into the single strike that is both the 2,747-lot call wall and the static gamma flip, above which dealers turn long gamma and dampen.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20 pt width - 5.25 net credit = 14.75 pts; max gain 5.25 pts below 1080; breakeven 1085.25.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1100, where the call wall and the gamma flip sit together.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1030 / 1000
strategies.rationale: Cheap defined-risk tail insurance for a futures book at 3.00 pts, sited on the 1030 strike that took today's single largest put volume (365 lots against 1,621 OI) and inside the -1,526 / -810 baht/pt gamma strip that would carry an accelerating break.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit 3.00 pts (6.00 paid - 3.00 received); max gain 27.00 pts at or below 1000; breakeven 1027.00.
strategies.invalidation: A reclaim of 1070 with 25D skew retreating back under +1.50.

S50U26.prediction: Base case is a 1050-1080 range with a fat downside tail: 1 sigma is 9.34 pts a day, so the 1050 wall is a single-sigma move away, and the -2,238 baht/pt of gamma parked there means a close below it is amplified toward 1030 and 1020 rather than absorbed. Bias stays neutral-to-bearish while spot holds under the 1070 max pain it crossed beneath today. A close back above 1080, where +2,914 baht/pt of dealer long gamma begins absorbing, invalidates the downside lean and returns the series to the dampened 1080-1100 shelf.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no execution is recommended. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1070 max pain and the 1050 / 1100 walls as tendencies, not guarantees. Defined risk is not risk-free - the stated max losses of 6.05, 14.75 and 3.00 pts are real and can be taken in full, and short-vol payoffs carry negative skew. The 16,128-lot 910 put wall is stale structural OI (117 lots traded, 154 pts away) and should not be read as active support, and at 27 DTE a macro or news shock can override the entire option structure.
